name: Remote Media Transcription
description: Add a transcription field to remote-video media types.
project_description:
Remote Media Transcription 
 A Drupal module that enhances accessibility by enabling transcription capabilities for remote video media entities. This module allows users to add, manage, and display video transcriptions in a user-friendly format.

 Features 
 ✅ Add and manage transcriptions for remote video media entities

✅ WYSIWYG editor support for rich text transcriptions

✅ Customizable button texts and animation effects

✅ Compatible with Drupal 8 & 9 & 10

 Installation & Configuration 
 
 Install and enable the module. 
 Navigate to `/admin/config/media/remote-media-transcription` to configure: 
 
 Default transcription visibility 
 Button labels for toggling transcription 
 Animation speed for smooth transitions 
 
 3. Set user permissions at `/admin/people/permissions` :

 
 Administer Remote Media Transcription 
 
 Usage 
 
 Edit a remote video media entity. 
 
 
 Locate the "Video Transcription" section. 
 
 
 Add your transcription using the WYSIWYG editor. 
 
 
 Save the entity—transcription appears below the video with a toggle button.
 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Media Module 
 
 
 Media Library Module
